title: Market price
description: What the book is paying for Up right now, in cents on the dollar. Down is always one dollar minus Up.

up.label: Up
up.description: The market's current odds that BTC finishes above the strike, as a price in cents. Fifty cents is a coin flip.

bid.label: Best bid
bid.description: The highest price someone is waiting to pay for Up. Selling Up right now fills here.

ask.label: Best ask
ask.description: The lowest price someone is waiting to sell Up at. Buying Up right now fills here.

last.label: Last trade
last.description: The price of the most recent fill in this round. It lags the book when nobody is trading.
